llm_response.reason: The site impersonates Studio Anneloes, a genuine Dutch fashion brand, but does not provide any verifiable company information, business registration, or legitimate contact details (no address, no business email, no phone number). The privacy policy is vague and fails to reference any regulatory compliance. The contact page uses only a basic form (no direct business contact means) and fails to list ownership or management details. Security claims are contradicted by SSL certificate issues. The tactics used fit multiple scam signals: non-existent company info, ambiguous privacy note, inappropriate contact methods, and spoofing a legitimate brand. All this is consistent with a fake online shopping scam.
